Real 3D files for src/dev/mesh_part_probe.gd: a part of one's own from an STL or OBJ (MeshPart).
Each is redistributed here under its own licence, as its source page states it (fetched 2026-11-23).
The fourth hair piece the probe reads, the 3.4 MB ponytail (CC0 1.0, VicArtGil,
https://www.printables.com/model/1607412-hair-for-110-tpu-join-action-figure-eva-02), is not kept here: pass --files=.

path:        hair-wig67/wig_67.stl
what:        Minifigure hair ("Wig 67"), scaled 8.33x from a LEGO-style hair and
             cut flat at the back (made to sit on a wall-mounted toilet-roll holder head).
             At 1/8.33 scale it is about 13 x 9 x 7 mm, which is minifigure size.
source page: https://www.printables.com/model/561113-large-scale-minifigure-hair

author:      Pugwash
licence:     Creative Commons — Attribution (CC-BY), 4.0 International
             The page says the author started from "a low-poly OBJ of original minifigure hair";
             no remix parent is listed.

EXTRA (an open-mesh case, not one of the three main hair pieces)
path:        hair-emka/hair-emka.stl
what:        Hair made for a large printable "LEGO Character" figure. NOT watertight: 96 edges
             belong to only one triangle. It is useful for testing how the importer handles an
             open mesh.
